description: This Java class 'ArtifactInfoContext' is used for gathering and managing artifact-related information such as entity names, service names, and various location sets within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ArtifactInfoContext
classes.description: A final class that maintains sets of artifact-related identifiers and provides methods to add and retrieve these sets.

methods.name: addEntityName
methods.description: Adds a non-null entity name to the entityNameSet.

methods.name: addFormLocation
methods.description: Adds a non-null form location to the formLocationSet.

methods.name: addRequestLocation
methods.description: Adds a non-null request location to the requestLocationSet.

methods.name: addScreenLocation
methods.description: Adds a non-null screen location to the screenLocationSet.

methods.name: addServiceName
methods.description: Adds a non-null service name to the serviceNameSet.

methods.name: addTargetLocation
methods.description: Adds a non-null target location to the targetLocationSet.

methods.name: getEntityNames
methods.description: Returns the set of entity names.

methods.name: getFormLocations
methods.description: Returns the set of form locations.

methods.name: getRequestLocations
methods.description: Returns the set of request locations.

methods.name: getScreenLocations
methods.description: Returns the set of screen locations.

methods.name: getServiceNames
methods.description: Returns the set of service names.

methods.name: getTargetLocations
methods.description: Returns the set of target locations.
